title: Monk Timotheus says other monks have seen the light of the Virgin Mary

tellings.quote: people monks have said they've seen the This is the light of the Virgin Mary going down the the thing and I just seems like you might have seen that.

plain: In 1991, at Dionysiou monastery on Mount Athos in Greece, a monk named Timotheus is said to have told a visitor that other monks had seen "the light of the Virgin Mary" coming down, and that the visitor might have seen it too. Ralph Larson, the guest who visited the monastery and saw something there, tells Michels what the monk told him. If true, it would put Larson's experience in line with what the monks themselves say they see.
